Assistant: Understood — that supersedes my pending question, and it's a cleaner approach: a real consumer PoC (nutsack) will drive exactly what the NMP wallet integration needs. Let me ground myself in the old product first, then launch the Opus spec agent and file the mint-discovery issue. [...] 
**Reframing note:** this supersedes my earlier "how far to drive W1–W13" question (which timed out) — nutsack becomes the consumer PoC that *drives* exactly what NMP must expose, rather than me autonomously blasting the internal wallet build. The spec's gap list will tell us precisely which W-items are load-bearing for a green end-to-end run. [...] nutsack scaffolded, spec'd, and gap-filed. Repo: /Users/pablofernandez/Work/nutsack (git init'd, 2 commits, builds green, tests pass).

WHAT I SCAFFOLDED (cargo workspace, builds green with `nmp-backend` feature OFF — the honest state until NMP is consumable):
- crates/nutsack-core — app-core: typed `nmp.wallet.*` action builders, the bounded `WalletProjection` mirror, config (testnut + relays), and the `NutsackApp` composition handle over nmp-native-runtime. ZERO wallet logic. Real NMP deps are commented/feature-gated with TODO pins.
- crates/nutsack-tui — ratatui shell skeleton (`nutsack` bin), screen map, single-frame render smoke; event-loop is a documented TODO cloned from the in-repo nmp-gallery-tui.
- tests/ (nutsack-acceptance) — headless two-party round-trip harness + `#[ignore]`d acceptance test + `scripts/run-acceptance.sh`.
Unit tests: 2 pass (incl. a tripwire asserting action payloads carry no proof/secret/privkey). Acceptance test correctly ignored with the blocker in its message.
 [...] SPEC.md (main deliverable): product scope + non-goals; the 6 user flows; TUI screen map; thin-shell architecture mapped to the design doc's Product Surface (the 8 MVP actions + the bounded "wallet" projection, both mirrored 1:1 in code); testnut default config + relay-acquisition boundary (NMP owns relay set via kind:10019/NIP-65, not app-provided); security invariants; and the NMP gap list (§9). Explicitly states end-to-end is blocked until the NMP backend lands. [...] ACCEPTANCE-TEST DESIGN: two fresh nsecs → each `cashu.create` + `nutzap.publish_info` → each deposit value-less ecash from testnut (`deposit_quote`→`complete_deposit`, auto-settle, no Lightning) → A nutzaps B, B nutzaps A → each redeems → assert both balances/history via the projection only. Ephemeral relay via `nak serve`. Harness TODOs (spawn relay, generate keys via NMP adapter, no-polling await helpers) are marked. One-command runner in place.
